Game Overview

Baseball for Clowns is a sports title where join Henk, a legendary baseball player, as he battles mischievous jokers in zany, action-packed levels. Use your baseball skills to outsmart and eliminate the jesters, reclaiming Henk's glory. Dive into this whimsical adventure and help Henk swing his way back to the top!
